programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil

She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? programme.title: Dr. Phil

In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.desc: Based on Arkady Fiedler's bestseller, Squadron 303 relates the true story of the Polish pilots who were heroes in the Battle of Britain. Jan Zumbach is recovering from a plane crash in a sanatorium when WWII breaks out. The Nazi onslaught forces him to escape from occupied Poland. A similar fate awaits the heroic flight instructor, Witold Urbanowicz. Both make their way to Great Britain and carry on the fight against the Nazi Luftwaffe. Quickly, their heroism and skill catch the attention of commanders, and an elite, Polish fighter squadron is created: Squadron 303. At first they are underestimated and mocked, but thanks to the outstanding patriotism and bravery of its members, the squadron quickly wins respect.

programme.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization, Part II: The Metal Years
programme.desc: The second in Penelope Spheeris’ trilogy, The Metal Years takes a fast-paced look at the outrageous Heavy Metal scene of the late '80s. Set in Los Angeles, the film explores fascinating portraits of struggling musicians, fans and star-struck groupies. Featuring Alice Cooper, Ozzy Osbourne, Poison and members of Aerosmith, Kiss, and Motorhead as well as performances by Megadeath, Faster Pussycat, Lizzy Borden, London, Odin and Seduce, this raucous and entertaining chapter also chronicles the lonely naiveté of the striving bands, the endless flow of alcohol and drugs and the relentless sexism.

programme.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization
programme.desc: Penelope Spheeris' The Decline Of Western Civilization is a riveting, unflinching and hard-core film which adeptly captures the spirit of a major cultural phenomenon. Including performances by X, Circle Jerks, Black Flag, Catholic Discipline, Germs and Alice Bag Band. Breaking down barriers of expression and social mores, the Decline punks were against everything: They gave birth to an anti-establishment view of the world that permeates today's music, politics, social attitudes, styles and trends. The film documents their deliberate reaction to the mass commercialism of music; it is a blatant and angry rejection of the mainstream. Burgeoning at the time, many of the punk bands first seen here have become legendary. The effect of the film on current day music, styles and trends is immeasurable.

programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.title: What's in the Barn

For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The high-voltage group stage of the World Pickleball League (WPL) nears its end on Day 8 with a crucial tie between the Hyderabad Superstars and the Chennai Super Champs. The commentary team sets the stage for a tense match, which is determined by an incredibly close final scoreline and points difference, with all six teams still in the running for the four semi-final spots. Also witness the Exhibition Match of the Century featuring Bollywood superstars Aamir Ali (Team Aamir) and Ali Fazal (Team Ali), live from the CCI Brabourne Stadium.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: Live from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome, Italy, witness back-to-back high-stakes matchups. First, in Women's Doubles Open, Team England’s Thaddea Lock and Katie Morris face off against Team France’s Elodie Busson and Adeline Nguyen. In a "nip and tuck" group decider, both teams trade aggressive volleys and "shake and bake" attacks before England finds a tactical edge to break the deadlock.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The storied rivalry between the North Carolina Tar Heels and the NC State Wolfpack reaches a fever pitch on the pickleball court during the 2024 DUPR Virginia Beach Super Regional semi-finals. Watch as standout players like Ian Hunter—a 2023 national challenger bracket champion—and Faith Eichner battle against NC State's seasoned duo of Peter Glass and Lauren Hutchinson. With strategic roster shifts and high-stakes rallies, both teams fight for every point to secure regional dominance and avoid a winner-take-all Dream Breaker finale. Experience the intensity of this intrastate clash as North Carolina's premier collegiate talent vies for a spot in the championship match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: Catch the exhilarating Men's Pro Doubles match from the 2025 Minto US Open Pickleball Championships, powered by Margaritaville! Witness incredible action on the Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida, the paradise coast for pickleball. This thrilling match features the dynamic duo of John Cangelosi and Michael Leonard against their formidable opponents. Get ready for intense rallies, powerful shots, and strategic play from top professional pickleball players. Don't miss this must-watch event from the epicenter of pickleball!

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Sheri Courter and Christine Karges take on Diane Wainio and Karin Kochis in this Women's Senior Pro Backdraw Match.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022
programme.desc: Heisman Trophy winning quarterback Danny Wuerffel & Pickleball pro Kyle Yates compete against US Olympian Casey Patterson & Pickleball pro Chuck Taylor in the final game of Picklebowl 2022.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the pinnacle of collegiate pickleball as Virginia Tech and Liberty University battle for the NCPA 2025 Virginia Beach Regional title. This high-stakes championship matchup features a prize pool of $2,500 and a chance for regional dominance.The action kicks off with an elite men’s doubles match featuring Liberty’s Ben Rice and Derek Cray against Virginia Tech’s undefeated Cody Miller and Caelan Funk. The broadcast also captures intense singles play and critical mixed doubles rallies as both teams fight through high-tension dink battles and "Dreambreaker" level strategy. Watch for standout defensive plays, including ATP (Around the Post) attempts and high-speed hand battles on the Championship Court at Pickleball Virginia Beach.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025, this fierce "Commonwealth Clash" features Virginia Tech taking on their in-state rivals, the University of Virginia (UVA). This pivotal pool play match is part of the fourth regional of the season, with teams vying for crucial seeding and a bid to the National Championship.The episode showcases intense action, starting with Women's Doubles, where UVA's Armelle Worrell and Mia Kim face off against Virginia Tech's Amelia Gaze and Heather Murphy. Later, watch the high-stakes Men's Singles match between Virginia Tech's Cody Miller, known for his reach and strategic placement, and UVA's Braden Cizek, who fights to keep his team in the series. With Virginia Tech leading 3-1 entering the singles match, every point counts.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Là pour rester
programme.sub-title: Les restaurants St-Hubert et le tapis sauve pantalon
programme.desc: Dans les années 50, un couple de Québécois décide de se lancer en restauration en achetant une rôtisserie de la rue St-Hubert ; les restaurants St-Hubert sont partout dans la province en raison de prises de décisions avant-gardistes.

programme.title: Là pour rester
programme.sub-title: La motoneige et le Jos Louis
programme.desc: Mis en marché par Bombardier dans les années 60, le Ski-doo est un symbole de fierté nationale et une marque reconnue internationalement, bien que plusieurs ignorent que l'idée de la motoneige est venue à son créateur lors d'un épisode tragique.

programme.title: La bouffe qui a forgé le monde
programme.sub-title: L'histoire du biscuit aux brisures de chocolat
programme.desc: Un professeur change de carrière pour devenir restaurateur et invente le biscuit le plus populaire aux États-Unis. Son invention déclenche une véritable bataille entre des géants du monde de l'alimentation et mène à l'apparition d'un des biscuits emballés les plus emblématiques de l'histoire.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Tout sur le menu avec Braun Strowman
programme.desc: Atlanta est une ville qui fait tout avec passion, et Braun Strowman est venu goûter à tout. Il plonge dans le monde du barbecue et des beignets aux côtés des légendes du hip-hop Killer Mike et T.I., et explore la riche culture culinaire d'ATL avec ces deux voix iconiques lui servant de guides. La nourriture est intense, la compagnie légendaire, et Atlanta s'impose comme l'une des plus grandes capitales gastronomiques de la saison.

programme.title: Steak, blé d'Inde, patates
programme.sub-title: De la pêche à la table
programme.desc: On plonge dans l'histoire surprenante du fleuve Saint-Laurent, de nos lacs et nos rivières ; Jonathan Roberge parle de cet héritage marin unique avec le chef Chuck Hughes et le journaliste Pierre Gingras.

programme.title: Les jouets qui ont forgé le monde
programme.desc: Grâce aux innovations révolutionnaires de trois hommes qui ont créé des jeux tels que "Super Mario Bros.", "The Legend of Zelda" et "Pokémon," Nintendo passe d'une entreprise de cartes à jouer en difficulté à un géant du jeu vidéo.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Soif de révolution
programme.desc: On retrouve les quatre amis derrière Les Grands Bois, qui brassent de la bière tout en s'amusant; ensemble, ils encannent la Giorgio, une pilsner d'inspiration italienne qu'ils présenteront dans un festival de bière à Milan.

programme.title: 3 secondes
programme.desc: La lutte professionnelle connaît présentement un regain de popularité aux quatre coins du Québec ; en suivant Marc Roussel, alias Marko Estrada, et le lutteur-promoteur Steve Boutet, alias Stephen Sullivan, on dresse un état des lieux.

programme.title: Les meilleurs moments de Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Les prêteurs sur gages parcourent l'univers à la recherche de bonnes affaires, que ce soit une voiture remplie de souvenirs signés de Star Trek ou une réplique de la DeLorean de "Retour vers le futur.".

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La malédiction du condamné: la légende de l'or perdu
programme.desc: Après avoir abandonné sa mission la saison dernière, le prospecteur solitaire David Muise revient et cherche un partenaire; l'entrée inexplorée de la vallée cachée de David intrigue Adam, qui est prêt à vivre une nouvelle aventure.

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Au large des côtes de la Nouvelle-Écosse se trouve une petite île mystérieuse. Vers la fin des années 1700, des empreintes étranges marquent le début d'une quête. Qu'est-ce qui se cache sous Oak Island? La chasse au trésor a coûté jusqu'ici des millions de dollars et a impliqué des dizaines de spéculateurs, ingénieurs, personnalités connues comme Franklin D. Roosevelt. Tous ceux qui ont tenté de percer le mystère sont restés sur leur appétit. Les frères Rick et Marty Lagina du Michigan veulent à tout prix décoder les secrets de l'île. Marty a dépensé une fortune pour acheter l'accès à l'île. Ce riche magnat du pétrole est prêt à déployer la technologie et l'équipement nécessaires pour creuser comme jamais auparavant.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Le secret du ranch Skinwalker
programme.desc: Des événements stupéfiants se produisent à l'endroit même où l'équipe a observé des phénomènes aérospatiaux non identifiés; une vache est retrouvée morte dans des circonstances plus que troublantes.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Au-delà du ranch Skinwalker
programme.desc: Andy et Paul retournent visiter un ranch de bétail du Colorado; la propriété est reconnue pour les nombreuses mutilations d'animaux qui s'y sont déroulées au cours des 25 dernières années; certains croient également qu'un mystérieux pont sur le terrain du ranch serait en fait un portail interdimensionnel; Andy et Paul y font la découverte de stupéfiantes preuves scientifiques qui seraient directement liées au ranch Skinwalker.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: De l'acier et du feu
programme.sub-title: Les Lames De Marvel's Midnight Suns
programme.desc: Dans le troisième épisode d'une compétition spéciale se déroulant en quatre parties, quatre forgerons se transforment en super-héros puisque l'univers de Marvel prend le contrôle de la compétition; les concurrents entrent dans une véritable course contre la montre pour recréer des armes d'un des jeux vidéo de Marvel.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Après deux ans d'attente, l'équipe reçoit les données de topographie des muons et apprend que la cavité connue sous le nom de "grotte d'Aladin" pourrait avoir d'autres secrets à révéler.

programme.title: Notre guerre
programme.desc: Le descendant d'une infirmière de la Première Guerre mondiale tuée lors d'un crime de guerre enquête sur l'histoire qui se cache derrière une intrigante photo.

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire
programme.desc: Pendant des décennies, les experts ont cru connaître la cause de la catastrophe de l'Hindenburg ; c'est une fuite d'hydrogène qui aurait enflammé le plus grand véhicule aérien de l'Histoire, provoquant son explosion ; cependant, cette histoire pourrait être bien plus complexe qu'elle ne le paraît ; cette explosion a sonné le glas de toute l'industrie des dirigeables ; qu'est-ce qui a réellement causé la catastrophe du dirigeable allemand Hindenburg ?

programme.title: Secrets de villages
programme.sub-title: Sarcophage, croix gammée et village fantôme
programme.desc: Un sarcophage serait submergé dans le parc sous-marin de Saint-Anicet; des ancres de bateaux affichant des croix gammées sont dans le parc muséal de Pointe-des-Cascades; ces secrets invitent Luis à découvrir la région de Montérégie.

programme.title: Les a$ de la brocante
programme.desc: Mike et Jersey se déchaînent dans un magasin de Virginie-Occidentale ; le défunt père de Barbara avait l'habitude d'acheter des stocks excédentaires, et il a laissé derrière lui une collection épique.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Pawn Stars: prêteurs sur gages en tournée
programme.desc: Prise deux au Michigan pour Rick, Corey et Chumlee; les gars prouvent qu'ils ont le football dans le sang en faisant une incursion dans le repaire des Wolverines.

programme.title: La fièvre des encans: nouvelle génération
programme.sub-title: Chevreuil sympathique et banc chapeau de gendarme
programme.desc: Situé à Sainte-Eulalie, le commerce Antiquité Michel Prince est un incontournable pour tous les habitués de l'autoroute 20 entre Québec et Montréal ; pour célébrer son 45e anniversaire, les propriétaires invitent leur clientèle à un encan événement.

programme.title: La fièvre des encans: nouvelle génération
programme.desc: Bob surprend toute l'équipe en découvrant une pièce passée complètement sous le radar de ses deux acolytes friands d'antiquités ; Karine et Dominic sont sous le choc.

programme.title: Les rois de la récup
programme.desc: Ted, Brandon et Rochelle se rendent à Belleville dans le but de voir si une vieille ferme et une ancienne usine à chapeaux peuvent être récupérées; dans le grenier, Ted met la main sur deux mystérieux portraits datant de 200 ans.

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Les dernières données signalent une cible intéressante dans la cavité connue sous le nom de grotte d'Aladin, un vide où l'on a trouvé de fortes traces d'or et d'argent ; l'équipe y découvre ce qui semble être des entrées et des sorties artificielles.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Kidd et Harry traversent des eaux vives intenses pour atteindre les frayères des truites arc-en-ciel. Jake perd ses chiens après qu'ils ont suivi les traces d'un puma dans un territoire lointain et inconnu. Paul vérifie ses pièges et remporte le plus gros lot de la montagne. Eustace fabrique des poutres massives pour réparer un quai en mauvais état dans une marina locale. Aron et Jen scient leur propre bois et reconstruisent le toit d'une cabane.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Jake et ses chiens abattent trois chats en une seule journée; Paul prépare son chargement de fourrure d'hiver pour le marché et explore une nouvelle parcelle de terre qui lui appartiendra; Eustace construit un ascenseur à bateaux en utilisant des troncs d'arbres massifs et une poulie à palan; Aron s'efforce de rétablir l'eau courante sur sa propriété, tandis que Jen prépare la serre pour la saison des cultures; Ray soumet son chien à une série d'exercices de recherche et de sauvetage.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire
programme.desc: L'histoire du guerrier le plus célèbre de tous les temps ne cesse de susciter de la fascination, plus de 2000 ans après son décès ; cependant, l'emplacement de sa dépouille fait l'objet de nombreux débats ; lorsque ses restes disparaissent soudainement, sans laisser de traces, d'importantes recherches sont lancées ; qu'est-il réellement arrivé à la momie d'Alexandre le Grand ?

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La vie après nous
programme.desc: À la disparition de l'humanité, la machine commerciale mondiale en viendrait à connaître un grand effondrement : des centres commerciaux délabrés, des voies maritimes dangereuses et des épiceries métamorphosées en champs de bataille pour rongeurs et prédateurs de toutes sortes. Pourtant, certains vestiges de la culture de la consommation, comme des objets en or ou du miel, pourraient survivre à la civilisation elle-même.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Secrets déclassifiés avec David Duchovny
programme.desc: Quels sont tous ces secrets cachés et inexpliqués ? David Duchovny nous ouvre la porte des bases gouvernementales ultra-secrètes, nous dévoilant quelques-unes des opérations clandestines qui s'y déroulent ; un laboratoire de poison mortel est exploité par un tristement célèbre médecin de l'Union soviétique ; un immense site de missiles nucléaires est enfoui sous la calotte glaciaire du Groenland ; un bunker apocalyptique du gouvernement américain est dissimulé dans une montagne.

programme.desc: "Crash" is about the strange lure of the auto collision, provoking as it does the human fascination with death and the tendency to eroticize danger. Most motorists will slow down to stare at the scene of a collision; they may feel their pulses quickening and become aware of the fragility of their own bodies. The characters of "Crash" carry this awareness a step further, cherishing and nurturing it. For them, a car collision is a sexual turn-on, and a jolting life force they come to crave.

programme.title: A Time to Love and a Time to Die
programme.desc: Retreating from the Russian front after the failure to take Moscow in 1944, German soldier Ernst Graeber (John Gavin) is granted a three-week furlough. He returns to his home village for the first time since he left two years before and is shocked to learn that his parents are among the thousands left dead or missing by the Allied bombing raids. Then he falls for the beautiful Elizabeth Kruse (Lilo Pulver), and the two attempt to begin a romance amidst the devastation and despair of the war.

programme.title: Julia
programme.desc: This Oscar-winning drama, based on the writing of Lillian Hellman, depicts the relationship between two friends and its unexpected consequences. After Lillian (Jane Fonda), a renowned playwright, reunites in Russia with her childhood playmate Julia (Vanessa Redgrave), the writer is recruited to smuggle funds into Germany to aid the anti-Nazi movement. Waiting in the wings is Lillian's lover and mentor, Dashiell Hammett (Jason Robards), who is unaware of her dangerous assignment.

But soon, her past disrupts her new vivacity, and Eilis must choose between two countries and the lives that exist within.

Tensions, menaces et forte opposition de la police locale n'arriveront pas à empêcher le quête de la jeune femme. La mère de Simon, elle, ne l'apprécie pas, avant d'être tuée dans un accident. Un homme qu'ils rencontrent pendant leur lune de miel fait des avances à Mélanie... The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Kandi drängt eine aufgewühlte Kim dazu, sich ihren Ängsten zu stellen und die Musikszene von Atlanta wieder zu betreten. Shereé ist wieder Single und will sich mithilfe ihres teuren Fitnesstrainers in Form bringen, der versucht, ihre Liebe zu gewinnen. Unterdessen bretzeln sich alle Damen für eine Gala auf, bei der ihre hochkarätigen "Alter Ego"-Fotos gezeigt werden sollen. Der Abend nimmt jedoch eine dramatische Wende, als Kim einen schweren Unfall hat und dadurch allen die Schau stiehlt.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Die zweite Staffel des Doku-Soap-Straßenfegers bot eine solche Überfülle von Dramatik, dass wir nicht umhinkonnten, den Zuschauern Nachschub zu liefern. Das explosive Wiedersehen wird deshalb als Zweiteiler ausgestrahlt. Erleben Sie mit, was sich im letzten Teil des Spezials ereignet.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Camille merkt, dass ihre Ehe durch Kelseys Aufenthalt in New York Risse bekommen hat. Auch Taylor versucht, ihre Ehe zu reparieren. Die Richards feiern den ersten Collegeabschluss der Familie: den von Kyles Tochter Farrah. Kyle ist jedoch wütend darüber.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: NeNes Freund Dwight überzeugt sie, ihren Ärger über Shereés Party hinunterzuschlucken. Kim organisiert unterdessen für ihre Tochter eine eigene Party. NeNe und Shereé begraben für einen Tag das Kriegsbeil. Lisa kann nicht kommen, da sie krank wird.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Neues Drama und alte Bekannte finden sich bei Lisas Party zur Eröffnung der neuen Lounge im Sur, und eine zerzauste Kim gesteht Kim die Wahrheit über ihren neuen Freund Ken.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Die Verlobungsparty von Lisas Tochter ist das gesellschaftliche Event der Saison - Kamele, Schlangen und Zirkusartisten inklusive. Kim ist jedoch nicht anwesend und versteckt ein Geheimnis vor Kyle.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Camille lädt Kyle zum Schwimmen und Tennisspielen ein - ein unbeholfener Versuch, um ihre Freundschaft zu reparieren. Lisas Gast Cedric enthüllt Tragisches über seine Vergangenheit, und Kyle organisiert für Mauricios 40. Geburtstag eine White Party.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: DeShawn beginnt mit der Suche nach den perfekten Angestellten für ihre Villa, während Lisa lernt, ihr Unternehmen mit ihrem Dasein als Mutter in Einklang zu bringen. Shereé plant eine Party, um ihr Leben nach der Scheidung zu feiern. NeNe will durch spätes Auftauchen extra Eindruck schinden, doch da sie nicht auf der Liste der geladenen Gäste steht, missglückt dies.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Bethenny vertraut sich Jill an und erzählt ihr, wie es um ihre Beziehung zu Jason steht. Jill bemüht sich, sie zu trösten. LuAnn, Bethenny und Ramona treffen sich, während Jill versucht, alles über den Neuzugang Kelly herauszufinden, woraufhin es zu einem Streit mit Ramona kommt. Beim Besuch einer Party, von der sie berichten soll, wird Kelly indes wie ein VIP behandelt.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Direkt nach ihrem Streit mit Kandi und Kim distanziert sich NeNe noch weiter von den Beiden. Kim und Kandi schließen gemeinsam die Aufnahme von "Tardy for the Party" gerade rechtzeitig für ihre gemeinsame Geburtstagsfeier ab, auf der Big Papa eine Überraschung für Kim hat. Shereé lässt Dwight ihre Modenschau organisieren, während sie mit Tania nach New York fliegt, um die Muster für "She by Shereé" anzusehen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Die Van Kampens kehren von den Hamptons zurück, um für ihren alljährlichen Urlaub in St. Barts zu packen und ihr Haus für umfassende Renovierungsarbeiten vorzubereiten. LuAnn organisiert eine Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung in der Hope Lodge und bittet Ramona, Bethenny und Jill um Unterstützung. Während der Veranstaltung geraten Ramona und LuAnn wegen der schroffen Direktheit von Ramonas Kommentaren aneinander. Bethenny fühlt sich durch LuAnns Kommentar zu ihrem Social-Life-Titelblatt beleidigt.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Am Osterwochenende geht es bei den Housewives alles andere als friedlich zu. Adrienne nimmt ihren Ehemann nur widerwillig mit zu einem Fotoshooting mit einem heißen Männermodel in Las Vegas. Kyle wirft Kim bei einem Streit in ihrem Familien-Ferienhaus in Palm Desert vor, sie vernachlässige wegen ihrer Kinder ihr Privatleben.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: NeNe und Dwight unterhalten sich bei einem Besuch im Salon. Lisa denkt über einen Ausflug nach L.A. nach, um ihre Mutter zu besuchen. Als Kim erfährt, dass das Kindermädchen ihre Mädchen alleine zu Hause gelassen hat, ist sie außer sich. Später besuchen die Damen mit ihren Kindern eine Tutanchamun-Cocktailparty.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Taylor enthüllt die ungeschminkte Wahrheit über ihre Ehe, und Lisas Tochter Pandora heiratet in einer glamourösen "Millionen-Dollar-Zeremonie" auf dem Vanderpump-Anwesen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Kim und Shereé kehren zum "Tatort" beim FAB (?) zurück, um es wieder gut zu machen und eine Überraschungs-Verlobungsparty für Kandi und AJ zu planen. Shereés fertige Muster für ihre Kollektion "She by Shereé" kommen endlich an und sie zeigt sie Dwight zum ersten Mal. NeNe und ihr Onkel Mel reisen zu ihren Wurzeln in Athen, um Denene, der Co-Autorin ihres Buches, Einblick in ihr Leben als Kind zu geben.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Die Umbauarbeiten in Jills Haus sind endlich abgeschlossen. Sie lädt Bethenny ein, um die Resultate in Augenschein zu nehmen. Bei dieser Gelegenheit erfahren sie, dass Jills Tennistrainer nicht mit ihr im Doppel gegen Ramona und Mario antreten kann. Bethenny schlägt daraufhin vor, dass Simon einspringen könnte, was Ramona definitiv vor den Kopf stoßen würde. Die anderen fünf Damen besuchen das Match.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Gegen Ende der Sommerferien ist LuAnn damit beschäftigt, die Sachen für Victorias Wechsel an ein Internat zu packen. Ramona und Bethenny treffen sich in den Hamptons und tauschen sich über die jüngsten Streitereien mit LuAnn aus. Bethenny will sich mit LuAnn versöhnen und trifft sich mit ihr zum Mittagessen. Die Gräfin reagiert jedoch ungehalten auf Kritik.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Bravo-Fans bekommen eine Extra-Dosis Drama, denn eure liebsten Südstaatenmädels finden sich für eine Sondersendung von "The Real Housewives of Atlanta" noch einmal zusammen. Gastgeber ist Bravo-Programmchef Andy Cohen, der euch zeigt, was bei abgeschalteten Kameras passierte.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: In der turbulenten Auftaktfolge der zweiten Staffel bekommt Jill aufgrund eines Interviews, das sie der New York Post gab, Ärger mit Alex und Simon. Bethenny beschließt, den Sommer gemeinsam mit Jill auf ihrem Anwesen in den Hamptons zu verbringen, und genießt ihr gesellschaftliches Leben in vollen Zügen. Bei einer Benefizveranstaltung stellt LuAnn den anderen Damen den Neuzugang Kelly vor.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: In Vorbereitung auf das neue Schuljahr geht Jill mit Allyson auf eine anstrengende Einkaufstour in eine teure Boutique in Manhattan. Dort stellt sie fest, dass es eine Million Dollar kostet, ein Kind in der Stadt großzuziehen. Ramona besucht eine Modenschau, auf der sie Jill begegnet. Es kommt zu Spannungen, als Jill bemerkt, dass Ramona im Gegensatz zu ihr in der ersten Reihe sitzt. Alex und Simon schenken Francois anlässlich seines ersten Tages im Kindergarten eine neue Schulmappe.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Die Ladys aus Beverly Hills wollen Missverständnisse aus dem Weg räumen: Mit Talkmaster Andy Cohen diskutieren Taylor, Camille, Adrienne, Kim, Kyle und Lisa über die größten Eskapaden der Staffel und stellen sich Amerikas brennendsten Fragen. Teil 2 von 2.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Jill, Bethenny, Alex und LuAnn treffen sich in einem New Yorker Nobelrestaurant. LuAnn und Alex verstehen sich blendend, während Bethenny Alex' angeblich arrogantes Verhalten auf die Nerven geht. Alex und Simon gehen mit Jill und Bobby essen, die ihnen angeboten haben, ihre Beziehungen spielen zu lassen, um Francois einen Platz an einer Privatschule zu verschaffen. Bethenny und Jason planen ein romantisches Abendessen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Als Taylors Mann mit einer Klage gegen Camille droht, fürchten die anderen Frauen, dass sie die Nächsten sein könnten. Unter Tränen, Besorgnis und Wut erwägen sie, Taylor von Kyles jährlicher White Party auszuladen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Lisa und Taylor erobern Las Vegas für Pandoras Junggesellinnenabschied (inklusive Chippendales!), während es in Adriennes Casino mit den anderen Ladys wild zugeht.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Die Verlobungsparty von Lisas Tochter ist das gesellschaftliche Event der Saison - Kamele, Schlangen und Zirkusartisten inklusive. Kim ist jedoch nicht anwesend und versteckt ein Geheimnis vor Kyle.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: In dieser Folge bleibt niemand verschont: Die Ehemänner - und Giggy - sehen zu, wie in nie zuvor gezeigten Aufnahmen weitere Dramen und Peinlichkeiten der Housewives ans Tageslicht kommen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Die Stimmung ist nicht nur bei den Ladys angespannt, sondern auch bei Adriennes NBA-Team. Adrienne, Paul und Kim besuchen das letzte Spiel der Saison, aber die Fans sind nicht glücklich über den eventuellen Umzug, und die Lage wird gefährlich für die Maloofs. Währenddessen veranstaltet Kyle in Beverly Hills eine Cocktailparty, um Spenden für das Lollipop Theater Network zu sammeln.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Die Schönheiten aus Beverly Hills kehren mit einer zweiten Staffel voll Glitzer und Glamour zurück. In der ersten Folge sind die Ladys zu Gast bei Adriennes überschwänglicher Dinnerparty, um Camilles Gastrolle in einer beliebten Sitcom zu feiern. Doch bald entstehen Spannungen - wahre Gefühle kommen an die Oberfläche und offenbaren einen tiefen Graben zwischen den Freundinnen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Lisa und NeNe treffen sich mit DeShawn, um deren Geburtstag zu feiern, doch als NeNe anfängt, über Shereé zu lästern und Kims Musikkarriere schlechtzumachen, wendet sich die Stimmung. Musikproduzent Dallas Austin schickt Kim zu einem Musikcoach. Als Kim herausfindet, dass NeNe hinter ihrem Rücken über sie geredet hat, verstärken sich die Spannungen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Jill, Bethenny, Alex und LuAnn treffen sich in einem New Yorker Nobelrestaurant. LuAnn und Alex verstehen sich blendend, während Bethenny Alex' angeblich arrogantes Verhalten auf die Nerven geht. Bethenny und Jason planen ein romantisches Abendessen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Taylors Freundin Dana veranstaltet einen Spieleabend, doch die Dinge geraten außer Kontrolle, als Kim verdächtig viel Zeit auf der Toilette verbringt und Brandi ihre haarsträubenden Vermutungen für die Gründe dafür äußert.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Am Osterwochenende geht es bei den Housewives alles andere als friedlich zu. Kyle wirft Kim bei einem Streit in ihrem Familien-Ferienhaus in Palm Desert vor, sie vernachlässige wegen ihrer Kinder ihr Privatleben.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Finden Sie heraus, was wirklich in Atlanta abging, als eure liebsten Südstaatenmädels zur dramatischen und lang erwarteten zweiteiligen Sondersendung von "The Real Housewives of Atlanta" zusammenkamen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: In der ersten Folge nimmt Adrienne, deren Familie das Palms Casino Resort und die Sacramento Kings besitzt, die Ladys im Privatjet mit auf einen exklusiven VIP-Ausflug zu einem Basketballspiel. Mit dabei sind die gewitzte britische Restaurantbesitzerin Lisa, Paris Hiltons Tanten, die ehemaligen Kinderschauspielerinnen Kim und Kyle Richards, Kelsey Grammers Noch-Ehefrau Camille Grammer und die Schönheit Taylor aus Oklahoma, die in Beverly Hills ihre Träume verwirklichen will.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Die Schönheiten aus Beverly Hills sind zu Gast bei Andy Cohen, um die brisantesten und umstrittensten Momente der Staffel noch einmal zu erleben und zu kommentieren. Inmitten von Ausrastern und Make-up stehen die Ladys einander gegenüber, um sich ihren Problemen zu stellen und ihre Meinung zu sagen. Und ein Wiedersehen wäre natürlich nicht komplett ohne die heißesten Ehemänner von Beverly Hills.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Die Damen haben alle Hände voll zu tun. Ramona entwickelt ihre eigene Hautpflegelinie. LuAnn trifft sich mit einer Autorin, um ihr Buch "Class with the Countess" zu vollenden. Bethenny macht in einem Laden in Connecticut Werbung für ihre Backwarenreihe "Bethenny Bakes". Kelly reist nach LA, um ihre Schmucklinie mit einem Designer zu besprechen, während Simon etwas Besonderes für Alex' Geburtstag vorbereitet, aber die Nerven verliert, als die Überraschung teilweise verdorben wird.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Adriennes Familie sieht sich zu sehr schwerwiegenden Entscheidungen gezwungen, die ihr NBA-Team eventuell in eine gegnerische Stadt verlagern könnten. Sie besucht Sacramento für das möglicherweise allerletzte Heimspiel und lädt Kim ein, mitzukommen. Doch Kim scheint nicht ganz in Form zu sein, und Adrienne stellt endlich die Frage, die alle seit letztem Jahr beschäftigt... sie will von Kim wissen, ob sie trinkt.
